LOST_DIALOG.TITLE: Why was this deal lost?
LOST_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Moving to {stage} closes the deal. The reason goes into the deal history.
LOST_DIALOG.LABEL: Reason
LOST_DIALOG.PLACEHOLDER: Price, no response, chose a competitor…

STAGES.TITLE: Stages
STAGES.DESCRIPTION: Rename, reorder and add stages. Expected hours is how long a deal can sit in a stage before it counts as cold (24 when empty). Stages with deals cannot be deleted.
STAGES.NAME: Name
STAGES.DEFAULT_HELP: Deals opened automatically by a customer message go to the default pipeline.

CARD.TITLE: Deal
CARD.NONE: No deal for this contact yet.

NEW_PIPELINE.TITLE: New pipeline
NEW_PIPELINE.DESCRIPTION: It starts with the template stages, which you can rename or delete. Automatic deals keep opening in the default pipeline.
NEW_PIPELINE.NAME: Name

RISK.EXPECTED: This stage expects a move within {hours} h
RISK.FILTER_EMPTY: No deals at risk in this pipeline.

SCORE.TITLE: Score
SCORE.NONE: No score yet: Jev needs at least two signals from the conversation.

FACTORS.asked_proposal: asked for a price or proposal
FACTORS.recency_critical: no interaction for a long time

RADAR.DESCRIPTION: Open deals that went quiet — the ones that can die without an answer. The most urgent first.
RADAR.EMPTY: No deal at risk. Every open deal had an interaction within its stage's time.
RADAR.TAKEN_OVER: The conversation is yours now: the AI stopped answering it.
RADAR.TAKE_OVER_ERROR: Could not take over the conversation. Try again.
RADAR.NO_NEXT_STEP: {count} open deal has no next step | {count} open deals have no next step
RADAR.NO_NEXT_STEP_HELP: No pending task on the deal or the contact. Open it and add what comes next — this is the one number that should be zero.
RADAR.AWAITING_OUTCOME: {count} appointment already happened — did the customer show up? | {count} appointments already happened — did the customers show up?

TASKS.DESCRIPTION: What was agreed, with a due date — and what is already overdue with nobody on it.
TASKS.TITLE: What needs to be done
TASKS.TITLE_PLACEHOLDER: Send the proposal, call back, confirm the visit…
TASKS.NO_NEXT_STEP: No next step yet. Add a task so this deal does not go quiet.

EMPTY.pending: Nothing to do. Add a task from a deal in the conversation, or with New task.
